lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: why exponential growth eventually exceeds polynomial growth
lessonRef.title: Concept model B: why exponential growth eventually exceeds polynomial growth

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Compare these two examples. Find the step where they stop being the same.

steps: It is the multiplier per year.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A table of successive outputs reads 8, 24, 72, 216. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
choices: Exponential; successive outputs have a constant ratio of 3.
Linear; successive outputs differ by a constant 3.
Quadratic; the second differences are constant.
Neither; the pattern does not repeat.

items.prompt: A population of 600 grows by 10% per year. Write the model P(t) and find the population after 7 years, to the nearest whole number.
Quantity A grows by 92 units each year. Quantity B doubles or triples each year, with ratio 2, starting from a much smaller value. Which statement is true in the long run?
choices: B exceeds A only if B starts larger than A.
B eventually exceeds A and stays ahead, however large A’s constant increase is.
The two grow at the same eventual rate.
A stays ahead permanently because 92 is larger than 2.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: An asset's value is modelled by V(t) = 900(0.93)^t, with t in years. What does 900 represent?
choices: the total value lost over the asset's life
the value of the asset when it was new, $900
the fraction of value retained each year, 0.93, meaning a 7% annual loss
the number of years until the asset is worthless

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (6, 29) and (9, 44). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.
A table of successive outputs reads 18, 108, 648, 3888. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
choices: Exponential; successive outputs have a constant ratio of 6.
Linear; successive outputs differ by a constant 6.
Neither; the pattern does not repeat.
Quadratic; the second differences are constant.

items.prompt: A population of 800 grows by 12% per year. Write the model P(t) and find the population after 2 years, to the nearest whole number.
